package_for_local_executor: package an executable spec for local execution using bazel outputs and a packageable
package_bazel_binary: package a bazel binary target into a local executable with command path and arguments
package_bazel_container: package a bazel container target into a loaded container image for local execution
package_dockerfile: build a docker image from a dockerfile and return a loaded container image executable
package_python_container: build a python container image from a PythonContainer spec with args and env vars
